propositions: The review bot computes per-call token usage in runner._extract_usage but discards _usage token fields in the review path, recording only request count to CloudWatch.

finalize._attach_code_review_metrics must aggregate input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, and total_tokens across all _usage-bearing succeeded agent steps (Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide) into coverage.metrics.

voter._publish_token_usage_metrics must emit five CloudWatch metrics (review_bot_llm_input_tokens, review_bot_llm_output_tokens, review_bot_llm_cache_read_tokens, review_bot_llm_cache_write_tokens, review_bot_llm_total_tokens) with Unit=Count to Namespace=rebar/host via best-effort boto3, swallowing import/credential failures.
review_and_vote must call the token publisher after a successful vote, reading totals from decision[verdict][coverage][metrics].
Pass-1 finder token usage is out of scope; a follow-up ticket will thread finder _usage through the plan-review path.
